Messages.Author: CalibanX
Messages.Body: Can a vamp play Revelation of Ecstacy on a tapped minion?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Please include cardtext in your question.

> Name: Revelation of Ecstasy
> [LotN:C/PS4]
> Cardtype: Action
> Discipline: Serpentis
> +1 stealth action.
> [ser]  Tap one of your prey's ready minions.
> [SER] As above, and place a corruption counter on that minion. If the number of your corruption counters on the minion equals or exceeds his or her capacity or cost, you may burn those counters to take control of him or her.
>
Answer is "yes". You can tap tapped minions, or untap tapped minions as effects.

If it were a cost, it would be different ("Tap X to ..." requires X to be untapped)

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
> Name: Revelation of Ecstasy
> [LotN:C/PS4]
> Cardtype: Action
> Discipline: Serpentis
> +1 stealth action.
> [ser]  Tap one of your prey's ready minions.
> [SER] As above, and place a corruption counter on that minion. If the number of your corruption counters on the minion equals or exceeds his or her capacity or cost, you may burn those counters to take control of him or her.
>
The only restriction is that the prey's minion be "ready", not necessarily "untapped and ready."
